biggest_catch: Rewards are per survey with screen-outs — surveys are not guaranteed and pay small cash amounts each, so the effective hourly rate is low; the advantage is only that there is no minimum cashout, so even one survey's earnings can be withdrawn.
catches: Per-survey cash amounts are small (third-party reports roughly $0.25-$0.75 per survey); no guaranteed number of surveys.
Screen-outs happen; surveys are matched to your profile and spots can fill quickly.
Available in the US, UK, France, Australia, and Germany only (per third-party reports) — not global.
Qmee's browser extension/app tracks browsing activity for search/cashback rewards — a privacy trade-off worth knowing.
